## Topic 1 · Mechanism Design {#mechanism-design}

VCG, auctions, matching, voting — designing the rules of the game. [Topic page →](../../tutorials/mechanism-design/index.qmd)

::: {#topic-mechanism-design .course-contents}
:::

## Topic 2 · Auction Theory {#auction-theory-deep-dive}

Revenue equivalence, Myerson optimal, combinatorial, GSP, empirical methods. [Topic page →](../../tutorials/auction-theory-deep-dive/index.qmd)

::: {#topic-auction-theory-deep-dive .course-contents}
:::

## Topic 3 · Behavioral Economics {#behavioral-economics}

Prospect theory, nudges, heuristics, time preferences, social norms. [Topic page →](../../tutorials/behavioral-economics/index.qmd)

::: {#topic-behavioral-economics .course-contents}
:::

## Topic 4 · Experimental Economics {#experimental-economics}

Lab and field experiments, oTree, classical replications, meta-analysis. [Topic page →](../../tutorials/experimental-economics/index.qmd)

::: {#topic-experimental-economics .course-contents}
:::

## Topic 5 · Cryptography & Game Theory {#cryptography-and-gt}

Blockchain incentives, MEV, DeFi games, cryptographic protocols as games. [Topic page →](../../tutorials/cryptography-and-gt/index.qmd)

::: {#topic-cryptography-and-gt .course-contents}
:::

## Topic 6 · Ethics and Game Theory {#ethics-and-game-theory}

Ethical dilemmas formalised, fairness, moral uncertainty, conventions, norms. [Topic page →](../../tutorials/ethics-and-game-theory/index.qmd)

::: {#topic-ethics-and-game-theory .course-contents}
:::

## Topic 7 · Ethics Applications {#ethics-applications}

Algorithmic fairness, AI safety, bioethics, climate justice, digital ethics. [Topic page →](../../tutorials/ethics-applications/index.qmd)

::: {#topic-ethics-applications .course-contents}
:::
